{{Otheruses|Smapp}}
'''Smapp''' was an entity that could be roasted. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] sold [[roast Smapp]] with hot [[barium liquid]] for 8.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> The [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] was part of the diner's [[Pantoran Plate Specials|Pantoran plate special]] available for lunch and dinner on [[Zhellday/Legends|Zhelldays]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
===Creation and design===
[[File:Smapp.png|thumb|300px|right|The illustration of the Smapp from ''Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas'']]
Smapp were first mentioned in ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a [[1993]] [[Canon|non-canon]] book written by [[Bob Carrau]] that collected various pieces of concept art from projects made by [[George Lucas]]. The entry for Smapp in the book was written in the style of an [[in-universe]] guide to purchasing and cooking Smapp. In the book, Smapp were a type of creature that could be found in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as both domesticated beasts and in the wild. The guide was accompanied by a picture of a Smapp's head, which had wrinkled [[Color/Legends|green]]-brown skin, a small black nose, large orange lips, small gray [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], a black horn on the side, and a small ridge of sparse black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] running down the neck.<ref name="Monsters" />

The domesticated Smapp were mentioned to be popular in the [[Leisure Fields]], which was described to be beyond a location known as [[Derso-4]]. The entry presented wild Smapp as better to eat, due to their taste, bogg consistency, and curling properties when cooked. It then described how, when, and where to obtain wild Smapp. Elderly wild Smapp were mentioned to only be good for making jerky, while buying a wild Smapp with humid, chartreuse [[Egg/Legends|egg]] sacs in-season near a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] eruption was a better choice, and capturing a wild specimen was best but the most time consuming and difficult.<ref name="Monsters">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>

===Cooking a Smapp===
[[File:BlueHutt-LoNH.png|thumb|300px|left|Cooking a Smapp could feed four to six Hutts (pictured)]]
The entry mentions a dish known as [[Hydrogenated Smapp]] and provides a recipe that called for a [[Butterflying|butterflied]] medium-sized Smapp, six quarts of viscous [[Butter/Legends|butter]], forty-five [[fern potato]]es, twelve tubes of [[Herbs de Lunar Eclipse]], a pinch of [[Zinc/Legends|zinc]], and [[Garlic/Legends|garlic]]. Preparing the dish required an oven heated to eight hundred degrees, shaving the Smapp, tenderizing it under its gilled flanks, removing its smoking orifices, and spreading a butter-herb mixture on it with a [[dental mop]]. Then the Smapp needed to be marinated for two [[Gravitational Rotation|gravitational rotations]], before it was seasoned with zinc and attached to a [[Steel/Legends|steel]] roasting board for cooking in the oven. The garlic was to be chewed by the cook while waiting for the creature to detonate, which could take one to three gravitational rotations.<ref name="Monsters" />

Upon completion, the cook used [[iodized forceps]] to remove the creature from the oven so it could be seasoned with [[ceiling ash]] and served as food, which was of a great enough quantity to feed four to six [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. As a footnote, the entry said that hot barium liquid went nicely with the dish during [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] [[Winter/Legends|winters]]. It was also stated elsewhere in the book that it was advised to cook Smapp over an elliptical flame to reduce solar scars.<ref name="Monsters" />

On [[December 3]], [[2009]], Smapp was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an in-universe menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
